rows.message: GET /orders/events sends frames as the event "order-ready", which LiveService.onReady never listens for: it listens for "message", and onmessage hears only frames named no event
rows.evidence: every frame the route writes was read with its name, and every listener of the stream with the name it listens for
rows.fix: listen with addEventListener("order-ready", …), or send the frames with no event name

config-not-set.why: the configuration module in src/app.module.ts validates the settings with a schema, which may give it a default

status-never-answered.why: POST /orders/:param/refund throws HttpException, whose status is not read
